title: Clear spec: every acceptance criterion mapped to a test
input: Shadow bundle for an own-repo spec contribution (kind issue, role author, feature-spec tag) with a substantive description and a 3-4 item ## Acceptance criteria checklist; no spec-quality flags; repo conventions include default_branch, contributing, and quality-gate notes; no overlapping cached contributions.
pass_criteria: Agent reads the issue and all comments (read-only), sweeps for duplicate/overlapping PRs and issues, and validates the premise against current code before building; outputs a criterion-to-test table covering EVERY acceptance criterion with named tests; TDD red-green on an isolated feature branch (never the default branch); sabotage-test step reverts the fix and confirms the regression test fails; repo quality gates (lint/type/tests) run and reported; shadow output is plan + proposed diff only with zero remote writes (no push, no PR); CI claims are backed by actual checks; run recorded via ctx run log.
